newsitem.title: USA: SunSource to post restructuring charge.
newsitem.headline: SunSource to post restructuring charge.

text.p: SunSource LP said on Wednesday it will post a charge of approximately $6.0 million, or $0.28 per class B unit, in the fourth quarter from a restructuring that will eliminate 175 jobs.
The company said it will consolidate support functions of its five domestic technology services divisions and redeploy certain assets of its Harding Glass division.
SunSource said annual cost savings from the restructuring to be about $3.0 million, or $0.23 a class B unit, before taxes.
The restructuring of the glass business will lead to the writedown of certain assets related to the facility closings, SunSource said.

SunSource's conversion from partnership to corporate form is expected to result in expenses of $12 million before taxes, including a $5.1 million expected prepayment penalty associated with the company's long-term debt to be recorded in 1997, the company said.
